fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s tourist season and civic harmony; criticism of federal actions including income tax assessments and prosecution delays; coverage of Prohibition-era rum-running and related events involving Nassau, Bimini, Gun Cay, Cat Cay, and Havana; discussion of Miami and Miami Beach municipal matters (harbor equipment and contracting, street work, parks/cleanup, policing, and grand jury activity); notes on labor conditions for local musicians; sports and entertainment listings including boxing and university athletics; and letters to the editor on apartment economics and community affairs.
